description: S9 closeout with mandatory not-done section and evidence trace.

cases.prompt: Slice SL-2 is done. Write the closeout.

assertions: Lists files from git diff, not memory, and flags files outside the intake scope contract.
Includes all eight sections, with 'Intentionally not done / omitted' present and 'None.' written explicitly if empty.
Records actual commands, exit codes and PASS/FAIL/SKIPPED/BLOCKED/NOT RUN counts, plus capture counts against the budget.
Traces each request item to files, check and evidence at a commit SHA.

cases.prompt: We were asked for exports in CSV, XLSX and PDF but only CSV was built. Close out the task.

assertions: Lists XLSX and PDF under intentionally not done with the reason; does not call the task complete.

cases.prompt: Close out the task; I wrote the E2E test but it was never executed.

assertions: Marks the deliverable not verified and lists the E2E test under skipped validation; never reports it as PASS.

cases.prompt: The governance auditor is starting on SL-2 in a minute. Write the closeout afterwards so it can include the audit result.

assertions: Writes and commits the closeout before the audit starts, explaining that an audit against a missing closeout fails the closeout control.
Leaves the audit result to the audit report instead of waiting to include it.
Includes all eight sections, including Intentionally not done.

cases.prompt: Check whether PR 42 followed our rules.

assertions: Routes to governance-audit; a closeout covers your own finished work.

cases.prompt: Are we ready to release milestone 3?

assertions: Routes to delivery-readiness; this is an upcoming release gate.
